reason: Adds image understanding, OCR, visual question answering, and reviewable persistent evidence to text-only DeepSeek Harness models through a configured vision route.

summaries.zh: 为文本型 DeepSeek Harness 模型提供图像理解、OCR、视觉问答和可在对话中查看的持久化视觉证据。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding, OCR, visual question answering, and reviewable persistent visual evidence to text-only DeepSeek Harness models.

capabilities: Analyzes selected conversation images through a configured vision model
Performs OCR and answers image-related questions
Maintains conversation-scoped visual context and follow-up memory
Stores structured visual evidence, attachment identifiers, and derived text in conversation history
Adds a vision model selector, Evidence tab, and evidence cards to the user interface
